high_level_description: This image is an aerial photograph of a residential area in Copenhagen, Denmark, as indicated by the post from the account "beautifuldestinations." The photo captures a snowy landscape with houses and their surrounding gardens, all enclosed within circular boundaries. The houses vary in size and color, with some having red roofs and others having gray or black roofs. The gardens are neatly trimmed, and there are pathways connecting the houses. The setting appears to be during winter, as evidenced by the snow covering the ground and the bare trees.
